description: This file defines the WorkShiftService class, which provides methods to manage and retrieve work shift information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes functions to get default start and end times for shifts, retrieve shifts by ID, fetch lists of shifts based on search parameters, and count shifts, utilizing associated DAO and DTO classes.

classes.name: WorkShiftService
classes.description: Service class that manages work shift data, including default times, retrieval by ID, listing, and counting, integrating DAO and configuration services.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDefaultStartAndEndTime
methods.description: Returns default start and end times for work shifts as a WorkShiftStartAndEndTime object.

methods.name: getWorkShiftById
methods.description: Retrieves a WorkShift entity by its unique identifier.

methods.name: getWorkShiftDao
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the WorkShiftDao instance.

methods.name: getWorkShiftList
methods.description: Returns a list of work shifts based on provided filter parameters.

methods.name: getWorkShiftCount
methods.description: Returns the count of work shifts matching the provided filter parameters.
